author: Leofiso10
quote: I would like to address several points to explain why I gave this game its rating.First: The woke agenda and LGBTQ+ elements have been forced into a game where they have absolutely no place.Second: After 13 years of waiting, the game failed to introduce any new mechanics or offer a genuinely fresh experience. Does the graphics alone justify a 99 rating? I honestly don’t know.Third: Based on my experience, the 30 FPS, stuttering, and various open-world performance issues had a significant impact on my experience. This is a major problem, and I genuinely couldn’t enjoy the game.Fourth: The excessive time spent on missions, where developers deliberately slow things down so you can admire their work, eventually makes the gameplay lose its enjoyment. Does fast travel hurt the game? Absolutely not. Whether someone wants to explore or travel quickly, both options support player freedom.Excessive realism isn’t necessarily a good thing. It restricts you to actions that would make sense in real life, when what you want from a video game is the freedom to do what you want without unnecessary **** many things have become tedious for the player because of these realism-driven restrictions. Why do I have to refuel my car? Why do I have to pay to repair it? Why am I given the option to break the window just to steal a car when pressing the enter-vehicle button already means I want to steal it? Why do I have to deal with electrical wiring puzzles?These mechanics had a significant negative impact on my experience and made the game unnecessarily complicated.There are many more points I could discuss, but I’ll leave it at that.

author: Leofiso10
quote: An absolute masterpiece. A game that has never lost its essence. If Zelda isn't art, then what is?
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
